An '''officer''' served as a [[clone stormtrooper]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[203rd Division]]. Shortly following the [[Cleansing of New Plympto]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and the 203rd were stationed at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and blocking any civilian ships from leaving. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] managed to sneak into the spaceport impersonating a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and steal an [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighter]] in order to create a ploy for the civilians to escape, the clone officer ordered their comrades to stop the ships by getting airborne. The officer was equipped with [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] in their unit's markings, a [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]], and a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]].<ref name="Dark Times 2" />
